title: False Ceiling — one Math Engine, perimeter cove band, central panel and cove LED
description:
A parametric FALSE CEILING on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A SPACE. It takes its extents from the host outline's bounding box, not from width and depth props, because a ceiling that could disagree with the room it sits in would be a second source of truth for the same rectangle. Margin insets it; Fit to host set to Exact stretches it back out.

TWO LEVELS, AND THE COVE IS THE GAP BETWEEN THEM. A perimeter band at `bandSoffit` and a central panel at `panelSoffit`. The cove is never drawn as a thing — it is the reveal that exists because the panel sits higher than the band, and `coveReveal` reports it. Set the panel below the band and the metric goes to zero, which is the honest answer.

THE PANEL FILLS WHAT THE BANDS LEAVE. `_pu0 = _u0 + _bwC + _pin` — each edge is inset only by the band that is actually on that side, so dropping to Long sides or Three sides widens the panel automatically rather than leaving a gap.

A SHADOW GAP IS AN INSET, NOT A SOLID. `_gapIn` simply adds to the panel inset on every banded side, so the gap and the panel cannot drift apart.

THE OPENING IS A SPLIT, NOT A SUBTRACTION. With `opening` on, the panel becomes four strips around the hole — left, right, below, above — because the quad-prism kernel extrudes plan quads and has no boolean. That is also why the hole is rectangular.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS, on a 3.962 × 3.734 m room: band soffit 2.972, panel soffit 3.124, a 0.152 m cove reveal, 0.381 m of void above the band, 14.17 m of band run and 10.47 m² of panel.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. The outline is the host's BOUNDING BOX — an L-shaped room gets a rectangular ceiling. There is no curved or chamfered cove profile: the kernel extrudes plan quads vertically, so Square, Stepped and Shadow gap are the three sections that can exist. Only one opening, and it is rectangular.

props.value: gypsum board, warm white matte emulsion, seamless taped joints

params.name: False Ceiling maths
params.expr:
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# The ceiling takes its EXTENTS FROM THE HOST, not from width/depth props. A ceiling that could
# disagree with the room it is in would be a second source of truth for the same rectangle.
_natL = _hostL
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = _natL * _s
_Wd = _hostW * _s
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _Wd
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Wd / 2
_v1 = _Wd / 2
# Levels. The COVE is not drawn — it is the reveal between the two soffits, and it exists
# because panelSoffit sits above bandSoffit. Invert them and the reveal reports as zero.
_slab = slabHeight
_bz = min(bandSoffit, _slab - 0.01)
_pz = min(max(panelSoffit, _bz), _slab - 0.005)
# Which of the four bands exist. u is the host's LONG axis, so the bands at v0 / v1 are the
# long runs and the bands at u0 / u1 are the end runs.
_all4 = bandSides == 'All four'
_only2L = bandSides == 'Long sides'
_only2S = bandSides == 'Short sides'
_three = bandSides == 'Three sides'
_hasA = _all4 || _only2L || _three
_hasB = _all4 || _only2L || _three
_hasC = _all4 || _only2S || _three
_hasD = _all4 || _only2S
_bw = min(bandWidth, min(_Ln, _Wd) / 2 - 0.05)
_bwA = _hasA ? _bw : 0
_bwB = _hasB ? _bw : 0
_bwC = _hasC ? _bw : 0
_bwD = _hasD ? _bw : 0
_bA0 = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v0 + _bw, _u0, _v0 + _bw, _bz, _slab, 1)
_bB0 = hcat(_u0, _v1 - _bw, _u1, _v1 - _bw, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, _bz, _slab, 1)
_bC0 = hcat(_u0, _v0 + _bwA, _u0 + _bw, _v0 + _bwA, _u0 + _bw, _v1 - _bwB, _u0, _v1 - _bwB, _bz, _slab, 1)
_bD0 = hcat(_u1 - _bw, _v0 + _bwA, _u1, _v0 + _bwA, _u1, _v1 - _bwB, _u1 - _bw, _v1 - _bwB, _bz, _slab, 1)
_BA = _hasA ? _bA0 : zeros(0, 11)
_BB = _hasB ? _bB0 : zeros(0, 11)
_BC = _hasC ? _bC0 : zeros(0, 11)
_BD = _hasD ? _bD0 : zeros(0, 11)
_BAND = vcat(_BA, _BB, _BC, _BD)
# The panel fills whatever the bands leave. A shadow gap is simply a wider inset on every side
# that has a band, so the gap and the panel cannot contradict each other.
_isStep = edgeProfile == 'Stepped'
_isGap = edgeProfile == 'Shadow gap'
_sw = min(stepWidth, _bw / 2)
_gapIn = _isGap ? _sw : 0
_pin = panelInset + _gapIn
_pu0 = _u0 + _bwC + _pin
_pu1 = _u1 - _bwD - _pin
_pv0 = _v0 + _bwA + _pin
_pv1 = _v1 - _bwB - _pin
_okPanel = (_pu1 - _pu0) > 0.05 && (_pv1 - _pv0) > 0.05
# Opening — the panel is cut by SPLITTING it into four strips, not by subtracting a solid.
_ol = min(openingLength, max(0.05, _pu1 - _pu0 - 0.05))
_ow = min(openingWidth, max(0.05, _pv1 - _pv0 - 0.05))
_oc = openingOffsetU
_od = openingOffsetV
_ou0 = max(_pu0, min(_oc - _ol / 2, _pu1 - _ol))
_ou1 = _ou0 + _ol
_ov0 = max(_pv0, min(_od - _ow / 2, _pv1 - _ow))
_ov1 = _ov0 + _ow
_pFull = hcat(_pu0, _pv0, _pu1, _pv0, _pu1, _pv1, _pu0, _pv1, _pz, _slab, 2)
_pL = hcat(_pu0, _pv0, _ou0, _pv0, _ou0, _pv1, _pu0, _pv1, _pz, _slab, 2)
_pR = hcat(_ou1, _pv0, _pu1, _pv0, _pu1, _pv1, _ou1, _pv1, _pz, _slab, 2)
_pB = hcat(_ou0, _pv0, _ou1, _pv0, _ou1, _ov0, _ou0, _ov0, _pz, _slab, 2)
_pT = hcat(_ou0, _ov1, _ou1, _ov1, _ou1, _pv1, _ou0, _pv1, _pz, _slab, 2)
_pCut = vcat(_pL, _pR, _pB, _pT)
_PANELr = opening > 0 ? _pCut : _pFull
_PANEL = _okPanel ? _PANELr : zeros(0, 11)
# Stepped lip — a narrow second drop hung on the band's inner edge.
_lz = _bz - _sw / 2
_lA0 = hcat(_u0 + _bwC, _v0 + _bwA - _sw, _u1 - _bwD, _v0 + _bwA - _sw, _u1 - _bwD, _v0 + _bwA, _u0 + _bwC, _v0 + _bwA, _lz, _bz, 3)
_lB0 = hcat(_u0 + _bwC, _v1 - _bwB, _u1 - _bwD, _v1 - _bwB, _u1 - _bwD, _v1 - _bwB + _sw, _u0 + _bwC, _v1 - _bwB + _sw, _lz, _bz, 3)
_lC0 = hcat(_u0 + _bwC - _sw, _v0 + _bwA, _u0 + _bwC, _v0 + _bwA, _u0 + _bwC, _v1 - _bwB, _u0 + _bwC - _sw, _v1 - _bwB, _lz, _bz, 3)
_lD0 = hcat(_u1 - _bwD, _v0 + _bwA, _u1 - _bwD + _sw, _v0 + _bwA, _u1 - _bwD + _sw, _v1 - _bwB, _u1 - _bwD, _v1 - _bwB, _lz, _bz, 3)
_LA = (_isStep && _hasA) ? _lA0 : zeros(0, 11)
_LB = (_isStep && _hasB) ? _lB0 : zeros(0, 11)
_LC = (_isStep && _hasC) ? _lC0 : zeros(0, 11)
_LD = (_isStep && _hasD) ? _lD0 : zeros(0, 11)
_LIP = vcat(_LA, _LB, _LC, _LD)
# Cove LED — sits ON TOP of the band soffit, inset from its inner edge, throwing up at the panel.
_lw = 0.014
_lt = 0.008
_li = min(ledInset, max(0, _bw - _lw - 0.005))
_ea0 = _v0 + _bwA - _li - _lw
_eb0 = _v1 - _bwB + _li
_ec0 = _u0 + _bwC - _li - _lw
_ed0 = _u1 - _bwD + _li
_gA0 = hcat(_u0 + _bwC, _ea0, _u1 - _bwD, _ea0, _u1 - _bwD, _ea0 + _lw, _u0 + _bwC, _ea0 + _lw, _bz, _bz + _lt, 4)
_gB0 = hcat(_u0 + _bwC, _eb0, _u1 - _bwD, _eb0, _u1 - _bwD, _eb0 + _lw, _u0 + _bwC, _eb0 + _lw, _bz, _bz + _lt, 4)
_gC0 = hcat(_ec0, _v0 + _bwA, _ec0 + _lw, _v0 + _bwA, _ec0 + _lw, _v1 - _bwB, _ec0, _v1 - _bwB, _bz, _bz + _lt, 4)
_gD0 = hcat(_ed0, _v0 + _bwA, _ed0 + _lw, _v0 + _bwA, _ed0 + _lw, _v1 - _bwB, _ed0, _v1 - _bwB, _bz, _bz + _lt, 4)
_GA = (coveLed > 0 && _hasA) ? _gA0 : zeros(0, 11)
_GB = (coveLed > 0 && _hasB) ? _gB0 : zeros(0, 11)
_GC = (coveLed > 0 && _hasC) ? _gC0 : zeros(0, 11)
_GD = (coveLed > 0 && _hasD) ? _gD0 : zeros(0, 11)
_LED = vcat(_GA, _GB, _GC, _GD)
Q = vcat(_BAND, _PANEL, _LIP, _LED)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Band3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Panel3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Lip3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Led3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
BandPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
PanelPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
LipPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
LedPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
coveReveal = _pz - _bz
clearHeight = _bz
panelHeight = _pz
voidDepth = _slab - _bz
bandRun = _hasA * _Ln + _hasB * _Ln + _hasC * (_Wd - _bwA - _bwB) + _hasD * (_Wd - _bwA - _bwB)
panelArea = _okPanel ? ((_pu1 - _pu0) * (_pv1 - _pv0) - (opening > 0 ? _ol * _ow : 0)) : 0
bandArea = _Ln * _Wd - (_pu1 - _pu0) * (_pv1 - _pv0)
ledRun = coveLed > 0 ? bandRun : 0
ceilingArea = _Ln * _Wd
